articles.detail: 7 cycles scheduled, only 2 completed (17:21 → 12 articles, 22:00 → 13); the 04:00/08:00/12:00/17:02 cycles all aborted at the selector on expired OAuth

experiment: Skipped, and a pause gate set through 2026-08-26. Every published metric today is inside targets, but they describe 2 hand-run cycles, not the pipeline — 16 consecutive scheduled cycles failed on expired OAuth, so there is no clean baseline to experiment against.
weakestArea: Not a metric — availability. From 2026-08-19 17:02 through 2026-08-22 17:02 every scheduled cycle died 4 seconds into Stage 1 with 'Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed', publishing 0 articles: 2026-08-20 shipped nothing at all and 2026-08-21 shipped 7. Credentials were re-authed at 17:14 today and the two cycles since have run clean, but the access token expires 2026-08-23T01:14Z, so the 04:00 run is the first real test of whether the refresh path works or whether this recurs.
watching: The 2026-08-23 04:00 cycle — the access token expires at 01:14Z, so that run proves whether the refresh token now works or whether the outage repeats and needs a non-interactive auth fix.

Sourcing is still the binding RVS cluster at 49 against writing 81 and coverage 96 (production RVS 76.03), consistent with the finding that selector-floor levers are tapped and gains must come from the upstream feed.
The weekly quality snapshot due Sunday 2026-08-24 22:00 will average across the outage days; read its deltas as artefacts of missing volume, not of writer or editor behaviour.
Feed supply held up throughout the outage (~380 deduped articles and 8–13 multi-source stories per cycle), so nothing upstream of the Claude CLI needs attention.
coverageGaps: Oceania is absent again today (0 of 25) — the one region that never clears the floor on its own.
Africa is thin at 2 of 25 despite Premium Times Nigeria, Mada Masr and SciDev.Net all appearing, suggesting single-story-per-outlet rather than a sourcing failure.
Two full days of coverage (2026-08-20 entirely, 2026-08-21 partially) are simply missing from the corpus and will read as a hole in any archive or trend view.
context: The queued 2026-05-08-numerical-density experiment remains un-promotable: it edits scripts/write-prompt.md, which daily tuning is not permitted to touch, and its blocker (2026-05-01-title-echo-self-check) closed months ago. It should either be handed to the operator as a prompt change or dropped from the queue rather than left blocking the slot.
